properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured on 0.76.0, 0.78.0 and main): the served hub skill reads and routes across a local hub's members, but has no step for ADDING one. Nothing served says where a member's store goes, how to keep it out of an upstream repository's git, what the pin looks like, or that each member write must name the member's export under --call. A work hub wrote this as its own project skill. Half of the reported gap, the member list, was fixed in 0.78.0
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-05, triaging art:vscode-call-field-log-2026-10-05, two entries of 2026-10-01.

① OBSERVED, the reporter's words: (1) "The served hub skill says a local hub's member list is the session's MCP config. Under --call there is none, so the list needs another home." (2) "The hub had no written procedure for adding a member, so one was written as a project skill: .github/skills/add-member-design/SKILL.md … Parts of it are generic and belong in reflow2's served hub skill: where a member's store lives and how it stays out of an upstream repo's git (.git/info/exclude, never reflow2 init in a repo you don't own), pin shape, and 'export after every member write' under --call." NOT affected: pinning itself worked ("external_dependency + upstream_status + compare_designs were enough to pin a second member … with no MCP").

② PRECEDENT: (1) is limitation 13 of art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02, walked in fact:root-cause-a-local-hubs-list-is-its-watch-manifest-but-the-hub-skill-names-the-mcp-config-and-no-pin-says-where-a-store-is-2026-10-02 (art:hub-skill CAUSES it). On the owner's word, fact:the-hub-address-book-idea-stays-open-and-the-hub-skill-wording-is-to-be-fixed-2026-10-02 left the address book open and fixed the wording. (2) has no precedent: no node mentions info/exclude, an add-member procedure, or a repository the person does not own.

⑤ MEASURED, get_skill hub served by each binary:
- 0.76.0, section 1: "one connection per child design in the session's MCP configuration. That configuration is the list."
- 0.78.0 and main: "Its list of designs is its declared dependencies … the same through MCP and through `--call`. The session's MCP configuration is not the list." So (1) is FIXED in 0.78.0 (#662, chg:the-hub-skill-names-a-local-hubs-declared-dependencies-as-its-list-2026-10-03).
- (2) on all three: no step adds a member. Separately measured today: a member store in a repository with no reflow2 configuration gets no export from a door write unless `--export-to` is passed (fact:recurrence-an-export-watch-reads-unchanged-over-a-members-unexported-work-2026-10-05). The reporter's "export after every member write" is therefore load-bearing, and only their project skill says it.

③④ CANDIDATES for (2): (a) the procedure is in another served skill (link-projects, parallel-work, adopt); (b) the hub skill was written from the consuming side, for a hub whose members are already connected; (c) the knowledge is per-site and does not belong in reflow2. (a): link-projects is about making two designs' interface real, and the hub skill's own description excludes it. A grep of every served skill on main for info/exclude finds none. (b) holds: the skill's trigger and sections all assume the designs are reachable. (c) is partly true: where a store lives on one machine is the open address-book question. But keeping it out of an upstream repo's git, the pin's shape, and naming the export on each write are generic.

⑥ CLASS: a served skill covers the steady state and not the setup step that a door user meets first. The setup knowledge then lives in one project's own skill, which is the 2026-09-28 "precedent in a project's files" shape.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether adding members belongs in hub or in a new skill. The served add_member tool the reporter proposed is an idea for the ideas triage.



PARTLY RETIRED 2026-10-07 by #694 (a5e5e645d): the /hub skill now says what to do when a member joins: ask whether it is part of the hub's design or a peer it uses, record it on the pin with external_dependency `relation` and `interfaces`, and run link-projects for each interface. upstream_status and loop_status report a member whose relation is not stated. Whether that answers everything this finding named was not re-checked line by line, so it stays open.
